Consider the following two statements: one is labeled
    as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).
    Assertion (A): Individual incentive schemes in
    schools can sometimes foster toxic competition
    and hoarding of teaching resources among staff.
    Reason (R): When rewards are limited and
    strictly linked to individual student outcomes,
    teachers may prioritize personal success over
    collaborative institutional objectives.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is (a) because both statements are true and R provides the correct explanation for A. R explains that when rewards are scarce and tied to individual outcomes, teachers may focus on personal success, leading to toxic competition and resource hoarding, which is what A describes. The other options are incorrect because they either misinterpret the relationship between A and R or incorrectly assert the truth of one statement over the other.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं और R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण प्रदान करता है। R यह बताता है कि जब पुरस्कार दुर्लभ होते हैं और व्यक्तिगत परिणामों से जुड़े होते हैं, तो शिक्षक व्यक्तिगत सफलता पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर सकते हैं, जिससे विषाक्त प्रतिस्पर्धा और संसाधनों का संचय होता है, जो A में वर्णित है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे A और R के बीच के संबंध को गलत तरीके से समझते हैं या एक कथन की सत्यता को दूसरे पर गलत तरीके से आरोपित करते हैं।

questions.question_english:
A Principal observes that despite announcing a
    ‘Best Innovator’ award, no teacher has submitted
    any new project. What is the most likely cause-
    effect relationship explaining this?
options_english: Cause: The award is seen as extremely prestigious; Effect: Teachers feel intimidated from participating
Cause: Generous baseline basic salary scale; Effect: Total apathy towards all school-level non-monetary awards
Cause: Lack of resources or instrumentality; Effect: No performance effort
Cause: Excessive frequency of staff meetings; Effect: Severe lack of time for developing innovative projects
questions.explanation_english: When an award fails to generate submissions, the primary cause is often a lack of necessary tools, guidance, or belief that effort will yield the reward. Under expectancy theory, if teachers lack resources or feel the award process is unattainable or arbitrary, effort drops to zero. Unclear pathways or inadequate institutional support negate the motivational pull of incentives.

questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'd' because tying quality assurance rewards exclusively to unspent year-end balances creates a severe design flaw by encouraging fund hoarding. questions.question_english: An effective incentive scheme must possess the characteristic of 'Transparency'. This means:
options_english: Every single employee receives the exact same reward regardless of individual performance or effort
The Principal decides all rewards in complete privacy to avoid open administrative arguments
The awarded rewards are kept completely invisible to the general public and school community
The criteria for earning incentives are clearly defined and communicated
questions.explanation_english: Transparency in incentive scheme design requires that performance criteria, evaluation methods, and reward eligibility guidelines are clearly defined and openly communicated to all staff. Transparency does not mean giving uniform rewards to everyone regardless of effort, nor does it involve secretive decision-making by school leadership.

      A TGT Science teacher in a government school is selected for an international training program.

questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रोत्साहन योजना को प्रभावी ढंग से लागू करने के लिए एक संरचित प्रबंधकीय प्रक्रिया का पालन करना आवश्यक है, जो विशिष्ट संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों को परिभाषित करने से शुरू होती है। इसके बाद, प्रशासनिक नेतृत्व उन पुरस्कारों के उपयुक्त प्रकारों का निर्धारण करता है, चाहे वे मौद्रिक हों या गैर-मौद्रिक, ताकि उन लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त किया जा सके। कर्मचारियों को मानदंडों की स्पष्ट संप्रेषणता सुनिश्चित करना पारदर्शिता और स्कूल में संरेखण को सुनिश्चित करता है। अंततः, समय-समय पर मूल्यांकन योजना के समग्र प्रदर्शन और मनोबल पर प्रभाव का आकलन करता है।
